hints: Each port has a sticker that names what plugs into it. Match the name on the lead to the name on the sticker.
Start with the fan lead. Port 3 is the one whose sticker says fan.
config.intro: The thermostat has five ports, and each one has a sticker naming what plugs into it. Wire every lead to the port whose sticker names it.

hints: Each stage works on what the one before it made. Follow one cookie from the moment it rides in raw to the moment it is packaged.
The fortune drops onto the round just after baking, while it is still warm, and just before the arms fold it.
config.intro: The Oven's stage list got shuffled by the steam. Put the stages back in the order one cookie goes through them.

steps.label: Fold each warm round around its fortune
Slide the cooled cookies into packages
Drop a printed fortune on each warm round
Raw rounds drop onto the Oven conveyor
Let the folded cookies cool and set

hints: Say each pair of lines aloud. The missing word at the end of a pair must sound like the word that ends the line above it.
Look at the word that ends the line above each blank, then pick the bank word that rhymes with it and makes sense.
config.intro: Steam smudged the packaging label, and the last word of two lines is gone. Pick the words that finish each rhyme.
lines: Fold it warm and let it cool,
Keep this side up, stay out of the rain,
Gopher will bring it down the {1}.

hints: Watch the light. Tap Press only while it glows, and let the dim beats go by.
The beat is a little slower now. Take your time.
config.intro: A warm cookie can only be folded for a moment. Watch the light and press when the arms should fold.

choices: The boxes are the wrong size
Gopher is busy on a delivery
lines: Well, hello there! I'm Gopher, the courier. I run packaging and delivery at the end of the Oven, so if a cookie leaves the shop, it left in my paws.
Every cookie gets its own wrapper first, so the fortune stays dry and the cookie stays whole. Then the wrappers go into boxes.
I never pack a cookie until it has cooled. A warm one steams up its wrapper, and the steam smudges the label. Ask me how I know.
My delivery routes are paper maps the gnu drew. Wonderful mapmaker. Terrible at writing down which way is up.
config.nudge: Think about what Gopher said happens when a warm cookie goes into its wrapper.
config.question: Why does Gopher wait for the cookies to cool before packing them?
config.speaker: Gopher
config.success_line: Right you are! That is the one.
